E.  ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

Joe Jimenez, Recreation and Community Services Director, announced that September 18 is the last
summer concert series and graduation banner pickup; youth volleyball and football are open for
registration; and provided an update on available programming and workshops at the Teen Center.

Steve Gomez, Public Safety Director, announced that they are enforcing all parking laws; and reminded
residents that the city has a home security camera rebate program.

F.  CITY ATTORNEY REPORT(S)
 Joe Jimenez, Recreation and Community Services Director, announced that September 18 is the last
summer concert series and graduation banner pickup; youth volleyball and football are open for
registration; and provided an update on available programming and workshops at the Teen Center.

Steve Gomez, Public Safety Director, announced that they are enforcing all parking laws; and reminded
residents that the city has a home security camera rebate program.

Neema Ghanbari, Public Works Director, announced the completion of the citywide curb painting
project; and announced that a block cleanup event will be held on September 19.

There were no City Attorney Reports.

There were no oral Council reports.

I.  ADJOURNMENT

The City Council adjourned the meeting at 8:09 PM to the next Regular City Council meeting to be held
on Wednesday, September 9, 2026 at 6:00 PM.
